rules.shared_contract_consumption: each root must import the shared contract package
rules.adapter_presence: each root must expose a declared transport or compatibility adapter
rules.navigation: global navigation must have one canonical owner; root-local navigation is reported as partial
rules.design_system: visual tokens or themes must have declared evidence
rules.runtime_binding: file presence alone is never sufficient proof of runtime binding
rules.authority: UI evidence never grants merge, approval, release, dispatch or execution authority
